fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 6209m) landed directly on the correct facility. Confirmed by a 'Keurig Dr Pepper' monument sign reading '2304' at the main entrance off Century Center Blvd. This is the Dr Pepper / Dallas-Fort Worth Bottling Company campus (The American Bottling Company, a KDP subsidiary).
fieldNotes.facility: Very large beverage manufacturing + distribution campus. One massive main warehouse/bottling building (with rooftop processing tanks/silos visible) plus several separate office, dock and shop buildings — campus → multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Century Center Blvd has a KDP monument sign and a small booth-footprint structure beside the entrance lane (guard booth). Truck circulation uses dedicated dock-side gates; multiple entry/exit driveways around the campus → truckGateCount 2, entryExitSeparate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure consistent with a guard booth sits beside the main entrance lane; medium confidence — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large dedicated trailer storage/drop yard on the SE side of the campus — dozens of rows of 53' trailers plus pallet/material storage, capacity well into the 200+ range.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band — extensive dock banks along the main building's south/southeast faces with trailers backed in; ~70 doors estimated, partly obscured — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: true — distinct dock clusters on different building faces (DSD van docks on the SW, large-trailer docks toward the trailer yard).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry drives and large paved circulation aprons — room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; a CSX/freight line and the Trinity River floodway run nearby but do not serve the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Las Colinas / Valley Ranch industrial district of Irving inside the Dallas-Fort Worth metro — Urban.

citations.claim: Active KDP Irving reqs (forklift operator, warehouse picker, production technician, sanitation lead) at the 2304 Century Center Blvd campus.
The American Bottling Company (Irving HQ) is a wholly-owned KDP subsidiary; the Dr Pepper / DFW Bottling campus is self-operated.

verification.rationale: American Bottling Company is a KDP subsidiary; monument sign + active KDP production/warehouse reqs at 2304 Century Center confirm current self-operation.
